editorial:
Imagine being ten years old and realizing your parents have a scary secret they keep from you. You follow them into a dark, old forest and see your dad turn into something not human. That is exactly what happens to Willow in this flick. The whole movie feels like a creepy campfire story come to life. It starts slow to build the mood, but once the secret comes out, it turns into a wild ride. You really feel for Willow as she tries to figure out why her family is like this and if she is doomed to change too.

The acting is great, especially the young lead who makes you care about her fate. Some parts of the story move a bit slow, but the scary transformations make up for it. If you love monster movies with a lot of family drama, you will dig this. For the best experience, you should stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the creature details. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go so you can watch it whenever you want.
endingExplained: In the end, you find out that the monster curse is passed down through the bloodline. Willow tries to fight it, but she eventually realizes she cannot escape her nature. The final scenes show her fully embracing the beast within her to protect what is left of her family. It wraps up with a dark twist where she becomes the new alpha of the forest, accepting her fate as a monster instead of a human girl.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves werewolf movies and dark family secrets.
